outcome: provision of maternity care (home births, referrals to obstetrician-led care)
maternal pregnancy-related outcomes (induction of labour, emergency caesarean section, obstetric anal sphincter injury, episiotomy, post-partum haemorrhage >1000 ml)
cohort: All births from a gestational age of 24+0 weeks in the Netherlands between 2010 and 2020 were included, totaling 1,039,728 births.
finding: During the first COVID-19 lockdown in the Netherlands, a substantial increase in homebirths was observed, but no significant changes were found in other measured maternal outcomes, suggesting the maternity care system adapted flexibly and safely.
mod_finding: A substantial increase in homebirths was seen (from 27% to +10%), while no significant changes were found in the incidence of induction of labour, emergency caesarean section, obstetric anal sphincter injury, or episiotomy.
